description: One NET demand mechanism in full: who benefits, what is delivered, the NET quantity and pricing policy, how NET is acquired or earned, the rights and responsibilities, expiry and refund terms, the authorizations it needs, its state machine, what happens on revocation, dispute or partial delivery, the proof of delivery, the receipts it produces, and the ecological claim it may and may not make. It also says exactly which rung of the evidence ladder it has reached and what blocks the next one. A contract is not activation, adoption, payment or an outcome. Free, keyless, read-only, moves no money.

id.description: The mechanism id from net_programs, e.g. 'agent-review-microservice'.

name: net_mechanism
title: One NET mechanism: its contract and where its evidence ladder stops
